title: novtt.session-event/1
description: One authoritative session event (SPEC-MVP-002 LT-03). Delivered on a private Reverb channel as event 'session.event' and by GET /sessions/{id}/events. seq is strictly increasing per session; a participant only sees the events of its audiences, so gaps are normal: refetch after the last seen seq when unsure. Consumers MUST deduplicate by seq.

payload.description: Shape by type: roll.* → OfficialRoll / RollRequest (openapi.v1.yaml); whisper.received → Whisper; note.* → MasterNote; clue.* → Clue; live.updated → {subject, live}; compass.updated → {revision, compass}; initiative.updated → {revision, initiative}; session.status → {status, title}; npc.revealed → RevealedNpc; plot.updated → {revision, plot, compass} (master); stage.updated → {revision, stage} (table); atmosphere.updated → Atmosphere (table); places.updated → Places (table); item_offer.* → ItemOffer (master, giver, receiver); clocks.updated → {clocks: PlayerClock[]} (one player, only when that player's visible clocks changed); portrait.updated → {kind, id, portrait_image_id}; suggestion.* → RollSuggestion or {id, status, roll_request_id}.
